traits.name: Amorphous
traits.text: The jelly can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra move- ment to do so.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.text: The jelly can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (3d6 + 2) Acid damage.

reactions.name: Split
reactions.text: Trigger: While the jelly is Large or Medium and has 10+ Hit Points, it becomes Bloodied or is subjected to Lightning or Slashing damage. Response: The jelly splits into two new Ochre Jellies. Each new jelly is one size smaller than the original jelly and acts on its Initia- tive. The original jelly’s Hit Points are divided evenly between the new jellies (round down). Ogre Ogre
